FIELDS.NAME: SecureSpace Storage Solutions
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
SecureSpace Storage Solutions operates a state-of-the-art self-storage facility dedicated to providing clients with secure and convenient storage solutions. Our facility features single-story and two-story units with controlled access systems, including electronic gate entry and 24/7 surveillance cameras, ensuring robust security for stored items. We adhere to strict safety protocols and comply with all local building codes, including the National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) standards. 

Each storage unit is regularly inspected and maintained to ensure cleanliness and safety, with on-site or contracted security personnel present at all times to deter theft and vandalism. 

We also offer climate-controlled units for temperature-sensitive items and maintain a retail area for packing supplies, such as boxes and tape, catering to customer needs. Our operations utilize an online platform to enhance customer interaction, streamline payments, and manage rental agreements effectively. Each portable storage unit is documented, with compliance to safety regulations enforced, ensuring a solid commitment to operational excellence and customer satisfaction.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On January 5, 2023, a water leak from a nearby property caused damage to three storage units, resulting in a loss of $2,500. The claim was reported and filed with our insurance provider, and the status is currently under review for approval.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: State-of-the-art secure storage vaults with UL-rated fire protection and climate control systems, designed to ensure the safety and integrity of all stored items.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: On-site security personnel present 24/7, electronic gate entry system, and continuous surveillance cameras.
